newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX AMSTERDAM V GLASGOW RANGERS TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX AMSTERDAM V GLASGOW RANGERS TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup Champions League Group A match between Ajax Amsterdam of the Netherlands and Glasgow Rangers of Scotland:

Ajax - 1-Edwin van der Sar, 2-John Veldman, 4-Frank de Boer, 5-Winston Bogarde, 6-Ronald de Boer, 7-Tajani Babangida, 11-Marc Overmars, 14-Martijn Reuser, 19-Arnold Scholten, 20-Marcio Santos, 21-Dani.

Glasgow Rangers - 1-Theo Snelders, 2-Alex Cleland, 3-Joerg Albertz, 4-Richard Gough, 6-Joachim Bjorklund, 7-Stuart McCall, 8-Paul Gascoigne, 11-Brian Laudrup, 20-Derek McInnes, 23-Craig Moore, 24-Ian Ferguson.
